stage.name: From the Light
stage.description:
Unwavering faith is the blade that will cut through the darkness and slay despair.
<Active Originium Storm> Deals True Damage to units in its area every second and greatly reduces their SP recovery.

sarkaz_wither_vanguard.name: Sarkaz Wither Vanguard
sarkaz_wither_vanguard.flavourText: Elites of the Nachzehrer King's armies, adept in Originium-rich environments. They draw power from Originium dust and fight until death claims them as nutrients for their comrades.
abilities: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.

caustic_originium_slug_enemy_1424_lrboom.name: Caustic Originium Slug
caustic_originium_slug_enemy_1424_lrboom.flavourText: Mutated Originium slugs around Londinium, altered by the rapidly changing environment. Filled with dangerous Originium particulates, their bodies explode upon death, spreading active Originium pollution.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.

sarkaz_wither_bulwark.name: Sarkaz Wither Bulwark
sarkaz_wither_bulwark.flavourText: Veteran guards of the Nachzehrer King's legions. Martyrs who advance to certain death knowing that others will carry their blood soaked shield.

sudaram.name: Sudaram
sudaram.flavourText: The Sudaram is the shroud of the dead. Once gaunt from hunger, it is now nourished by the power of the Nachzehrer King. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.
